notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
Today, the game has left the early access! Hooray!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31744133/8702f583cfb1f1a4a60f9d8fe3c3ea3413355b76.png[/img]

notes.title: We completed the story mode! (But the game has not been updated yet)
notes.content:
We want to report that we have completed the development of the history mode. We have added events in a large location "Munich". We also made the end of the game. The story mode is the main game mode, so it can be said that the game is almost finished!

However, we have not yet updated the game in Steam. We want to integrate new music tracks - they are also ready. Then, we are thinking of adding Steam achievements. And after that we will update the game.

Next, we plan to finish the special game modes - and after that the game will leave early access!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31744133/c6f8a5718c23ac1c47f012c25f8cd1e7871114fc.png[/img]
